sources.title: Chinese authoritative guideline source discovery; no individual guideline asserted
sources.organization: National Health Commission of the People's Republic of China; Chinese Medical Association and specialty branches; formal journals and national standards bodies (individual issuer must be recorded per guideline)
sources.notes: Discovery record only, not a clinical recommendation. Before a guideline entity is created, record exact title, issuing organization, year/version, publication, DOI, official URL, population, scope, recommendation system, review date and supersession. No model-memory completion.
